explain.totalSales: Gross order value for the selected period (or today on the home dashboard).
explain.totalCommissions: Commission amount credited in the selected period from the commissions ledger.
explain.todaySales: Gross value of all orders imported today (all sellers, all statuses tracked).
explain.todayCommissions: Commission amounts credited to wallets today from the commissions ledger.
explain.activeUsers: Sellers who were active during the selected period (or today on the home dashboard).
explain.deliveredSales: Value of orders marked delivered in the selected range.
explain.pendingPipeline: Value of orders still pending or processing — not delivered yet.
explain.newSellers: Sellers who joined during the selected range.
explain.withdrawals: Total withdrawal amount in the selected range.
explain.available: Sum of (balance − pending withdrawal) across every seller wallet — cash you can pay out now.
explain.held: Sum of onGoingOrdersBalance — commissions reserved on undelivered orders. Not in balance yet.
explain.pendingWithdrawalAmount: Cash already locked for pending payout requests (not free to reassign).
explain.earned: Lifetime commissions credited to seller wallets.
explain.withdrawn: Lifetime cash already paid out to sellers.
explain.walletCount: Number of seller wallets on the platform.
explain.pendingOrders: Orders still waiting to be processed.
explain.expectedGmv: Gross sales value of pending + processing orders still in flight.
explain.pipelineHeld: Commissions reserved on pending + processing orders until delivery.
explain.monthDelivered: Delivered order GMV imported this calendar month.
explain.monthCommissions: Commissions credited to wallets this calendar month.

wallets.summaryDesc: Grouped so withdrawable cash is separate from held and lifetime totals.

groups.heldDesc: Commission from orders that are not delivered yet.

explain.balance: Total credit in the wallet, including any amount currently locked for a pending withdrawal.
explain.available: Amount the seller can actually withdraw right now (balance minus pending withdrawal).
explain.pendingWithdrawal: Locked while a withdrawal request is awaiting review or payout.
explain.onGoingOrders: Earnings from orders not yet delivered. Not in balance yet — moves in once each order is marked delivered.
explain.totalEarned: Lifetime total of every credit ever added to this wallet.
explain.totalWithdrawn: Lifetime total of every withdrawal that has been paid out.

wallets.resetWarning: This will permanently zero out this user's wallet balance. This action cannot be undone.
wallets.resetWarningAll: This will permanently zero out ALL wallet balances across every user. This action cannot be undone.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Range P&L, contribution, trends, and team performance

section.todayDesc: Live snapshot for the current day
section.pipelineDesc: Orders, sales value, and commissions by status. Filter by seller or date. “On orders” is embedded sale commission; “Credited” is wallet ledger credits in the date range.
section.pnlDesc: Gross sales, costs, and contribution after commissions & expenses
section.trendsDesc: How GMV, costs, and contribution moved day by day
section.teamDesc: Active sellers, new joiners, and top performers in this range
section.secondaryDesc: Status mix and payout breakdown for the selected range

pnl.formula: Contribution = GMV − commissions credited − expenses. Withdrawals are cash outflow (liquidity), not subtracted here. Product COGS is not tracked.

charts.revenueCostsDesc: GMV, commissions, expenses, and contribution by day

team.topSellersDesc: Highest GMV in the selected range

analytics.salesByStatusDesc: Pick a date range (and optionally a seller) to see orders, sales, and commissions

explain.heldCommissions: Commission reserved on pending/processing orders and not released yet. Not withdrawable until the order is delivered.
explain.commissionCredited: Commission written to the wallet ledger in the selected date range (by credit date). Can differ from “on orders” when dates don’t match.
explain.commissionOnSales: Your/sellers’ commission already attached to these orders after delivery (from sale.commissions).
explain.networkSales: Sales attributed to the seller's downline network for the selected month.
explain.gmv: Gross merchandise value of tracked orders imported in the range (pending, processing, delivered, failed).
explain.commissions: Affiliate commissions credited to seller wallets in the range (ledger by credit date).
explain.expenses: Operating expenses recorded in the expenses module for the range.
explain.contribution: GMV minus commissions credited minus expenses. Not net profit — product COGS is not in the system.
explain.withdrawalsPaid: Cash paid out to sellers in the range (liquidity). Already counted as cost when commissions were credited.
explain.heldCommission: Live sum of commissions still held on undelivered orders across all wallets.
explain.activeSellers: Sellers with activity (lastActive) inside the selected range.
explain.newSellers: Sellers whose accounts were created in the selected range.
explain.deliveryRate: Delivered orders ÷ (delivered + failed) in the range.
explain.failedRate: Failed orders ÷ (delivered + failed) in the range.
